unchangedFrozenSubGates: attention timing and <=1 source-pixel gaze envelope

channels.core: translate with chest rise only; never scale or pulse

idleBreathing.notes: Replaces the visually insufficient v01 neck/torso float with visible local upper-chest breathing while keeping the 5000 ms cadence. Browser Critic tuning uses the upper end of the approved amplitude range so the motion reads at intended UI scale; no breast spring or secondary oscillation.

blink.construction: REF-FRONT source-derived upper-lid/upper-skin sample clipped to the true eye apertures; progressive upper coverage closes the aperture. Lower lid is effectively static; lash/closed line appears only near fully closed.
blink.notes: The old Stage 6 nested image stretch/rectangular eye-patch construction is retired. Timing remains 310 ms.

secondaryMotion.policy: shoulder leads; elbow follows; wrist is very small; brief hold; smooth monotonic settle

lifecyclePolicy.hiddenWindow: pause all animation/procedural clocks; zero intentional frames; discard hidden elapsed; resume without catch-up
lifecyclePolicy.retarget: preserve filtered attention state and breathing phase
